services.title: General Conveyancing
services.summary: Residential, commercial and sectional-title transfers, sales facilitation, commercial leases and general property transactions.
services.metaDescription: Residential, commercial and sectional-title transfers, sales facilitation, commercial leases and general property transactions.
body: Our conveyancing team attends personally to the tasks related to the sale and transfer of properties including: sales facilitation, commercial leases, property administration, management and development, as well as general property transactions.
We provide services for all property-related transfers including residential and commercial transactions, and sectional title schemes.

services.title: Project-related Conveyancing
services.summary: Township development from approval to transfer: development applications, township registers, bulk land transfers, subdivisions, consolidations and low-cost housing transfers.
services.metaDescription: HSG provides a boutique offering in project-related conveyancing spanning the entire township development process.
body: HSG provides a boutique offering in project-related conveyancing including all tasks related to development applications, opening of township registers, obtaining of compliance certificates, bulk land transfers, sub-division and consolidation and project related conveyancing including low cost housing transfers.
We provide an offering which takes the township development process from the approval stage to the transfer of homes and properties to the end user.

services.title: Property Law
services.summary: All aspects of property law for individuals, developers and public entities — contracts and leases, sectional title, timeshare and township establishment.
services.metaDescription: Our property law services deal with all aspects of property law irrespective of size or complexity for individuals, developers and public entities.
body: Our property law services deal with all aspects of property law irrespective of size or complexity. Our holistic offering includes private, corporate and public entity conveyancing and transfers, property related contracts and leases, Sectional Title and conventional conveyancing, sectional title development, property timeshare, and township establishment.
We assist individuals, developers and public entities with all aspects of their property projects.

services.title: Notarial Practice
services.summary: Admitted notaries for antenuptial contracts, notarial bonds, leases, servitudes, trusts, foreign wills and prospecting and mining contracts.
services.metaDescription: HSG’s notarial practice assists clients with the drafting and authentication of legal documents. Our notary attorneys have passed the practical exam and are admitted in the High Court.
body: HSG’s notarial practice assists clients with the drafting and the authentication of legal documents. Our notary attorneys have passed the practical exam and have been admitted in the High Court in order to practice.
Our experience in this field allows us to provide the following services:

• Registration of antenuptial contracts
  • Registration and cancellation of notarial bonds
  • Registration and cancellation of notarial lease agreements
  • Registration and cancellation of notarial servitudes
  • Registration of notarial trusts
  • Drafting of foreign notarial wills
  • Prospecting and mining contracts
  • General notarial practice and drafting of agreements

services.title: Land-Legal Solutions
services.summary: Identifying, rectifying and resolving complex tenure matters, with land surveyors and GIS specialists from the GeoAfrika Group alongside us.
services.metaDescription: HSG provides an offering that identifies, rectifies and resolves complicated tenure matters in respect of ownership, stability of tenure and transfer of land.
body: Within South Africa the ownership, stability of tenure and transfer of land can be affected by various impediments such as tenure conflict and insecurity, tenure, eviction processes and tenure rectification solutions.
HSG provides an offering that identifies, rectifies and resolves complicated tenure matters which are affected by these impasses.

Through our involvement with the GeoAfrika Group, we are able to network and partner with Professional Land Surveyors and Specialist Geographic Information Systems professionals in order to provide a holistic offering to resolving land tenure impediments.

services.title: Land Tenure Resolutions
services.summary: Resolving the tenure impediments that stall housing delivery and development — for landowners, municipalities, developers and communities.
services.metaDescription: Resolving the tenure impediments that stall housing delivery and development — for landowners, municipalities, developers and communities.
body: Insecure or disputed tenure is one of the most common reasons that housing delivery and development stall in South Africa. Since the 1990s HSG has worked on the land-legal teams that unlock it — from the KwaZulu-Natal Department of Housing’s land-legal team, which resolved obstacles to low-income housing delivery, to the Cato Manor Development Association, where the firm obtained an order in terms of section 34 of the Restitution of Land Rights Act 22 of 1994 to enable large-scale housing delivery.

We assist municipalities, developers and communities with land tenure matters and the acquisition of land in urban, rural and tribal areas for large-scale developments, including the Greater Edendale and Vulindlela Development Initiative in Pietermaritzburg.

Our tenure work draws on the wider land-legal offering: land-legal solutions for tenure rectification, project-related conveyancing for township establishment and transfer, and our planning and environmental teams for approvals.

services.title: Property Management
services.summary: Tailor-made management of commercial, residential, HOA and nationwide portfolios — acquisitions and disposals, leases, reporting and facilities.
services.metaDescription: HSG provides a tailor-made solution to your commercial, residential, Home Owners Association, and industrial property management needs.
body: HSG provides a tailor-made solution to your property management needs.

Depending on the size and type of management needed (Commercial, residential, Home Owners Association, nation-wide industrial management) we are able to provide a custom solution to your needs including an experienced management team dedicated to ensuring the smooth operation and management of your property investment.
Our current tasks include:

• Acquisition, ennoblement and disposal of land, Sectional Title Units, and retail space
  • Preparation of lease agreements including the reviewing and renewal of leases
  • Financial management reporting
  • Building Management
  • Management and tender procedures for service providers
  • Contractor selections (including B-BBEE credentials, capacity, resources, capabilities etc.)
  • Property inspections
  • Maintenance and facilities management
  • Administration Services including the coordination and minutes of Trustee and AGM meetings and Trustee portfolios, credit checks, reference confirmations and tenant screening etc

services.title: Planning Law
services.summary: Planning applications, objections, advice and planning agreements for landowners, developers and local authorities, grounded in SPLUMA.
services.metaDescription: Our dedicated conveyancing team provides a personal touch as it delivers on tasks related to the sale and transfer of properties
body: HSG has experience in all areas of planning law and policy.

We act for the landowner, developer and local authority clients on a variety of matters ranging from planning applications, objection letters, providing input and advice, and drafting planning agreements for mixed-use projects. Our understanding of and speciality with reference to the Spatial Land Use Management Act No 16 of 2003 provides accurate and precise input for our projects.
We aim to deliver practical, commercial and cost-effective solutions for clients.

services.title: Environmental Law
services.summary: Environmental authorisations, impact assessments, management programmes, compliance and opinion, with our own environmental specialists.
services.metaDescription: Environmental authorisations, impact assessments, management programmes, compliance and opinion, with our own environmental specialists.
body: South Africa has prioritised sustainable development. This includes care of the environment and forethought into the consequences of a development on the environment (underpinned by the National Environmental Management Act and associated regulations).
As a pioneer in the field of environmental law, HSG offers holistic environmental expertise to our clients. This includes the resources of our Environmental Attorney and Environmental Specialist.
Tasks in this offering include:

• The compilation of project environmental proposals, Environmental Management Programmes (EMPrs) and environmental reports, interpreting of specialist and technical reports
  • Conducting field surveys to establish a baseline condition for a site or area of consideration, and the production of environmental scanning reports
  • The undertaking of the role of an Environmental Assessment Practitioner and/or the management of the Environmental Authorisation Processes, such as the Basic Assessment Report (BA), and Scoping and Environmental Impact Reports (EIA)
  • Subcontracting and supervising the required specialists for the BA or EIA process
  • Acting as an Environmental Control Officer (ECO) to ensure the environmental compliance with the environmental authorisation of all contractors
  • Undertaking Project Development Applications and/or Preliminary Environmental Assessments
  • Reporting to the client on a regular basis detailing the status of the application
  • Providing legal environmental interpretation and opinion to clients
  • Appealing and/or amending environmental authorisations

services.title: Property-Related Litigation
services.summary: Advice and action on leases, offers to purchase, development rights, landlord–tenant disputes and evictions.
services.metaDescription: Advice and action on leases, offers to purchase, development rights, landlord–tenant disputes and evictions.
body: HSG offers clients specialised litigation with an emphasis on property-related matters. Our litigation team aims to assist clients when a problem arises with quick, tactical advice and responsive action.
We support our clients in resolving disputes using negotiation, arbitration, mediation and when necessary, court action.
Our main focus in Property-related Litigation is:

• Rental agreements
  • Offer to purchase
  • Property development rights / disputes
  • Landlord and tenant disputes; and
  • Eviction orders.

services.title: Arbitration and Mediation
services.summary: Accredited mediators and arbitrators, including co-mediation, for property, planning, landlord–tenant and commercial disputes.
services.metaDescription: Accredited mediators and arbitrators, including co-mediation, for property, planning, landlord–tenant and commercial disputes.
body: HSG offers qualified and accredited mediators to implement arbitration and mediation services in the commercial, civil and family arena.

Our offering of co-mediation services, arguably the best practice model for mediation especially in more complex situations or where there is an increased number of participants, provides our clients with an opportunity to utilise alternative dispute resolution techniques prior to undertaking expensive and timeous court proceedings.

The aim of our mediation services is to provide our clients with a method to avoid, manage and resolve disputes while retaining mutual respect between parties. Our attorneys are registered with the South African Association of Arbitrators.
We offer specialised mediation and co-mediation services related to dispute resolution in:

• Property related transactions
  • Planning and land use
  • Landlord and tenant disputes
  • General commercial transactions and agreements
  • Estate Management and Development disputes

services.summary: Sale, lease, partnership, joint-venture and shareholder agreements, transaction structuring, mergers and acquisitions and property-law agreements.
services.metaDescription: We provide exceptional commercial law services by providing accurate and practical advice as we progress through your matter.
body: Our commercial law offering comprises a full spectrum of Corporate and Commercial law services.
We aim to give accurate and practical advice as your matter progresses. Our services include:

• Drafting contracts and legal documentation for commercial contracts including Sale Agreements, Leases, Partnerships, Joint Ventures and Shareholder Agreements
  • Structuring transactions
  • Commercial Contracts
  • Mergers & Acquisitions
  • Business Structures & Joint Ventures
  • Property Law Agreements (including Licensing and Royalty Agreements)

services.title: Legal Costs Consulting
services.summary: Drafting and opposing bills of costs, attending taxations and settlement negotiations — for attorneys and their clients in the higher and lower courts.
services.metaDescription: Drafting and opposing bills of costs, attending taxations and settlement negotiations — for attorneys and their clients in the higher and lower courts.
body: As a professional, your time is precious. Creating legal bills of cost can be both time-consuming and monotonous. At HSG Attorneys Inc., our cost consultants focus on drafting and disputing legal bills of costs.
We also provide services for attending taxation and settlement negotiations. Contact our team of Cost Consultants and Attorneys today to care for all your legal costs requirements.
The following services are offered:
We prepare bills of costs in line with the relevant Court tariffs as between Party and Party and/or Attorney and Client in both Higher and Lower Courts.
Additionally, we create bills/statements based on each attorney’s specific tariff, helping attorneys provide accurate accounts, determine Costs for security, and aid in settlement negotiations.
Our fee for drafting bills of costs is charged at 11% of the total fee component of the bill as drafted, not taxed.
Opposing a legal bill of costs is as important as preparing one. The unsuccessful party may receive a bill from the successful party and has the right to contest any charges.

Our cost consultants are skilled in reviewing and opposing these bills, leveraging their expertise in relevant case law. When opposing bills of costs, our fee is charged at 10% of the gross amount by which a bill is reduced.
After receiving a bill of costs, the other side may file objections. We use our expertise in case law to prepare counter-objections, aiming to help you recover the maximum amount of legal fees.
